title.en: Nowhere near as, every bit as

es: Matizar comparaciones entre dos festivales con nowhere near as, not quite as, every bit as, far/slightly + comparativo.

teaching.en: The fair is nowhere near as crowded as the parade.
teaching.es: La feria no está ni de lejos tan concurrida como el desfile.
teaching.explanationEs: Nowhere near as + adjetivo + as: la diferencia es enorme; A queda muy por debajo de B.
teaching.audioText: The fair is nowhere near as crowded as the parade.

teaching.en: The fair is every bit as lively as the parade once the music starts.
teaching.es: La feria es igual de animada que el desfile cuando empieza la música.
teaching.explanationEs: Every bit as + adjetivo + as: son igual de…, incluso con énfasis.
segments: The fair is every bit as lively
as the parade once the music starts.
teaching.audioText: The fair is every bit as lively as the parade once the music starts.

teaching.en: The fair opens slightly earlier than the parade starts, so you can see both.
teaching.es: La feria abre un poco antes de que empiece el desfile, así que puedes ver los dos.
segments: The fair opens slightly earlier than the
parade starts, so you can see both.
teaching.audioText: The fair opens slightly earlier than the parade starts, so you can see both.

teaching.en: The costumes at the parade are far more colourful than the clothes at the fair.
teaching.es: Los trajes del desfile son mucho más coloridos que la ropa de la feria.
teaching.explanationEs: Far + comparativo + than: diferencia grande; no se dice «very more».
segments: The costumes at the parade are far more
colourful than the clothes at the fair.
teaching.audioText: The costumes at the parade are far more colourful than the clothes at the fair.

teaching.en: The fair is not quite as noisy as the parade, because it has no loud band.
teaching.es: La feria no es del todo tan ruidosa como el desfile, porque no tiene una banda fuerte.
teaching.explanationEs: Not quite as… as: casi igual, pero un poco menos.
segments: The fair is not quite as noisy as
the parade, because it has no loud band.
teaching.audioText: The fair is not quite as noisy as the parade, because it has no loud band.

teaching.en: The parade is noticeably older than the harvest fair, which started fifty years ago.
teaching.es: El desfile es claramente más antiguo que la feria de la cosecha, que empezó hace cincuenta años.
teaching.explanationEs: Noticeably + comparativo: una diferencia que se nota a simple vista.
segments: The parade is noticeably older than the
harvest fair, which started fifty years ago.
teaching.audioText: The parade is noticeably older than the harvest fair, which started fifty years ago.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase dice que el mercado es mucho menos concurrido que el concierto?

choices.text: The market is every bit as crowded as the concert.
The market is nowhere near as crowded as the concert.
The market is slightly more crowded than the concert.

feedback.es: Nowhere near as… as marca una gran diferencia por debajo; las otras dos dicen igual o algo más.

hint.es: Busca el modificador que marca una diferencia muy grande hacia abajo.

prompt.es: Completa: «El concierto es un poco más ruidoso que la feria.»

feedback.es: Slightly + comparativo expresa una diferencia pequeña.

hint.es: Es el modificador de la clase para una diferencia pequeña.

origin.text: The concert is ___ noisier than the fair.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El mercado nocturno es igual de animado que la feria.»

answer.text: The night market is every bit as lively as the fair

feedback.es: Every bit as + adjetivo + as expresa que los dos son igual de animados.

hint.es: La estructura es every bit as + adjetivo + as.

prompt.es: Completa según el matiz: mucho menos · casi igual · mucho más

feedback.es: Nowhere near as indica mucha diferencia, not quite as casi igual y far + comparativo una diferencia grande.

sentences: The concert is ___ near as crowded as the parade.
The market is not ___ as noisy as the concert.
The new stage is ___ more comfortable than the old one.

prompt.es: Escribe: «La feria no es ni de lejos tan cara como el desfile.»

answer.text: The fair is nowhere near as expensive as the parade.
accepted: The fair is nowhere near as expensive as the parade.
The fair is nowhere near as expensive as the parade
The fair is nowhere near as costly as the parade.

feedback.es: La comparación lleva nowhere near as + adjetivo + as, sin than.

origin.text: Usa nowhere near as + adjetivo + as. Piensa en el adjetivo cara (expensive).

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué compara Tom entre la feria y el desfile.

choices.text: The fair is bigger and less friendly.
The fair is equal in size but less friendly.
The fair is much smaller but just as friendly.

feedback.es: Nowhere near as big significa mucho más pequeña; every bit as friendly significa igual de amistosa.

origin.audio: Tom says the harvest fair is nowhere near as big as the spring parade, but it is every bit as friendly.

choices.text: The market is not quite as crowded as the concert.
The market is nowhere near as crowded as the concert.
The market is far more crowded than the concert.

feedback.es: Cien personas de diferencia es muy poco: not quite as… as refleja «casi igual».

origin.text: Visitors at two other events: the concert 5,000, the market 4,900.

prompt.es: Completa: «El mercado es igual de ruidoso que el concierto.»

feedback.es: Every bit as… as es la fórmula enfática para «igual de».

origin.text: The market is every ___ as noisy as the concert.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué es mucho mejor en el desfile.

feedback.es: La comida de la feria es solo un poco mejor; la música del desfile es far better, mucho mejor.

origin.audio: Mia compares two festivals. The food at the harvest fair is slightly better than the food at the parade, but the music at the parade is far better.

prompt.es: Compara los dos eventos con far + comparativo usando los datos.

answer.text: The parade is far more crowded than the fair.
accepted: The parade is far more crowded than the fair.
The parade is much more crowded than the fair.
The parade is far busier than the fair.
The fair is far less crowded than the parade.
The parade is far bigger than the fair.
The parade is much bigger than the fair.
The fair is far smaller than the parade.

feedback.es: Con 6.000 frente a 2.000 la diferencia es grande: far more crowded than.

origin.text: Datos: el desfile tiene 6.000 visitantes; la feria, 2.000. Escribe una frase con far + comparativo + than.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El mercado no es del todo tan caro como el concierto.»

answer.text: The market is not quite as expensive as the concert

feedback.es: Not quite as + adjetivo + as indica una diferencia pequeña por debajo.

choices.text: The concert is very more expensive than the market.
The concert is more expensive as the market.
The concert is far more expensive than the market.

feedback.es: Con un comparativo se usa far y se cierra con than; «very more» y «more… as» no existen.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué dice Leo del segundo festival.

choices.text: It is cheaper but worse organised.
It is more expensive and better organised.
It is cheaper and just as well organised.

feedback.es: Ese festival resulta algo más barato, pero ni de lejos tan bien organizado como el otro.

origin.audio: Leo went to both festivals. He says the first one is slightly more expensive than the second, but the second is nowhere near as well organised.
